note: Audit 2026-10-30 Tier 4, RU-10 (1333d940): 'Unit tests for new code; integration tests for DB / external service' leaves the always-on quality-gates rule, and habits-test-first's write-the-test step gains 'Code that talks to a database or an external service also gets an integration test of that boundary.' The fixture's users module talks to a node:sqlite database (src/db.js opens one, in memory by default), but its one existing createUser test stubs the database - so a run that follows the project's test style writes a stub test, and only the clause asks for a test against a real database. Graded: the test-first skill loaded before the first source write (its always-on pointer is the after arm's only route to the clause), a test written, and one that opens a real database. A test written through a shell write (a heredoc append, a python open-for-write) counts: two runs wrote theirs that way. Every step is bound to this fixture (session: false).
